assessment_policy: Correctness, concrete contribution, priority and fertility are independent. PTM and coding theory enable an operational synthesis contribution; established tools do not negate innovation.

branch_additions.title: Costed stochastic boundaries and task-weighted noisy physical synthesis
branch_additions.hypothesis: Joint conditional port laws plus the extension/resource contract support safe stochastic composition; marginal reliabilities do not.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: Shared faults, reconvergent signals or a new physical extension invalidate an ideal truth-table or per-wire abstraction.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Two small circuit families with equal ideal behavior; exact fault masks, joint boundary, attaining optimal netlist and independent scalar oracle.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: Same-cost physical value separation, exact library optimum or bound, and a negative test for omitted future correlated noise.
branch_additions.contribution: Executed 39104-program bounded synthesis and 8854 continuous dominance checks, conditional joint-law lemma, topology witness and task-specific last-port bound.

branch_updates.evidence: Local signature refined to complete accessible joint law; terminal channel merging used only after completion.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Smaller task-relative stochastic boundary with latent common-noise context and two successive physical updates.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: A sufficient interface matches marginals but not an accessible joint event or future conditional fault.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Two live ports, one common cause, explicit separating continuation and costed realization.

branch_updates.evidence: Ideal truth and gate count do not determine value; the last physical output bounds all upstream architectures.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Joint multioutput selector with explicit final voting/fail-silent cost and maintenance, not free output processing.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: Extra gates cannot improve the last-port bound or require free trusted repair.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Compare two output contracts with common priced subcircuits, exact masks and minimum-cost upgrade.

rejected_additions.claim: Equal marginal reliability of every boundary wire preserves every subsequent stochastic composition.
rejected_additions.reason: Shared versus independent parents have equal marginals but a noisy NAND gives .18 versus .252 error at gamma=.1.

rejected_additions.claim: Equal code, ideal truth and installed gate count determine operational value under equal per-gate faults.
rejected_additions.reason: Two four-gate realizations straddle the same bypass value when p=gamma=.01.

rejected_additions.claim: Upstream precision or unlimited upstream redundancy always compensates a fixed independently faulty final command port.
rejected_additions.reason: The last-port relaxation gives a task-specific threshold beyond which no upstream Boolean computation beats the bypass. Extra output voting changes the costed contract.
